company: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
title: Research Assistant
description: Batched Sparse Codes, supervised by Dr. Hoover Yin
highlights: Batched sparse codes process many sparse matrices, tensors, or graphs in parallel by operating only on active entries and are commonly used in wireless networks to efficiently represent packets for signal propagation.
Developed a Python simulator to replicate wireless communication in multi-hop networks with BATS Codes for packet encoding.
Conducted experiments to optimise batch sizes and intermediate-node buffer capacities, improving transmission efficiency under fragile, loss-prone network conditions
